title: FPL Squad Planner
tagline: Build a 15-man Fantasy Premier League squad against live prices, or pull up your own team's picks, bank, and chips
highlights: Two data strategies in one app: a GitHub Action refreshes shared player prices twice daily into a static file, while a Vercel serverless function proxies personal team lookups live — matching the fetch strategy to whether the data is shared or per-user
Enforces real squad-building rules client-side: £100m budget, 2/5/5/3 position quota, 3-per-club cap

Team lookup surfaces bank, team value, active chip, and this gameweek's transfer cost — and is explicit about the one thing the public API can't reliably provide (free transfers remaining) rather than guessing at it
